question: Who was elected President of the 80th United Nations General Assembly session in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annalena Baerbock.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Annalena Baerbock of Germany was elected as President of the 80th session of the United Nations General Assembly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **President-Elect:** Annalena Baerbock was elected to preside over the 80th session of the UN General Assembly, nominated by Germany.
 
• **Role:** She aims to serve as a unifier and an honest broker, engaging in trust-based dialogue with all Member States.
 
• **Regional Rotation:** Baerbock was elected in accordance with the regional rotation from the Western European and Other States Group.
 
• **Election Process:** The election was held during the 72nd plenary meeting of the General Assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **UN General Assembly:** The United Nations General Assembly is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations, serving as its main deliberative, policymaking, and representative organ.
 
• **Headquarters**: New York, United States.
 
• **Founded**: 1945, New York, United States.
